name: Local Recommendations
overview: Privacy-first personalized recommendations based on local watch history
description: Generate per-user content recommendations using TF-IDF embeddings and cosine similarity. All processing happens locally with zero tracking or cloud dependencies. Recommendations appear as virtual libraries accessible from all Jellyfin clients.

versions.changelog:
Expand diagnostic log with config snapshot, timing breakdown, exclusion summary, and top taste signals
- CONFIG section: shows all active settings for the run
- TIMING section: per-phase durations (library scan, vocabulary, embeddings, per-user)
- Exclusion summary per user: watched, in-progress, inaccessible, no-metadata counts and final candidate count
- Top taste signals: top-weighted vocabulary features driving each user's taste profile

Fix compatibility with Jellyfin 10.11.9
- Replace IUserManager.Users (removed in 10.11.9) with GetUsers() in RecommendationRefreshTask and BenchmarkTask
- Update SDK references to Jellyfin 10.11.9

Fix failing unit test in SyncRecommendations_SymlinksArtworkFromSourceFolder
- Test now correctly registers artwork paths via ImageInfos instead of relying on filesystem scanning
- No change to production code

Add recommendation diagnostic log
- After each refresh task, writes recommendation_log.txt to the plugin data folder
- Log contains: library size, vocabulary breakdown, embedding dimensions, and ranked recommendations per user with scores
- Viewable in the plugin Actions tab (Refresh Log / Download Log buttons)
- Warm-start users show cosine similarity scores; cold-start users show rating-based scores

Migrate from .strm files to filesystem symlinks (#13)
- Fixes transcoded playback on Jellyfin 10.11.7+ (GHSA-j2hf-x4q5-47j3)
- Symlinks preserve source extensions; media pipeline treats them as regular files
- Artwork symlinked from source folder (propagates custom posters automatically)
- Trailer discovery delegated to Jellyfin's native scanner
- Removed ImageSyncService and EnableImageSync/SyncBackdrops settings
- WINDOWS: requires Administrator or Developer Mode enabled for symlink creation

Filter recommendations by user library access (#10)
- Items from libraries a user cannot access are excluded from recommendations
- Applies to both personalized and cold-start recommendation paths
- Respects per-user library permissions including disabled libraries

Fix playback freeze when playing from recommendation libraries (#8)
- Never remove virtual library items from event handlers (deferred to next refresh)
- Ignore PlaybackStart/PlaybackProgress events to prevent DB write storms during playback
- Only sync play status on meaningful events (PlaybackFinished, TogglePlayed, etc.)
- Known tradeoff: partially watched items may appear in Continue Watching twice until next refresh

Bug fixes for series recommendations and playback crashes
- Fixed: Partially watched series not included in watch history, causing all users to get identical cold-start recommendations (#7)
- Fixed: Playback from recommendation libraries crashing with database failures (#8)
- Series watch history now detected at episode level instead of requiring all episodes watched
- Virtual library items no longer removed during active playback

Image sync for custom posters and backdrops
- Custom poster images are now preserved in recommendation libraries
- Copies poster.jpg and backdrop.jpg from source items to virtual folders
- Configurable: Enable/disable image sync and backdrop copying
- Fixes issue where user customizations (e.g., French posters) were lost

Decade-based temporal similarity and bug fix
- Recommendations now consider content from similar time periods
- Decade grouping (1980s, 1990s, etc.) replaces continuous year normalization
- Improves temporal relevance alongside genre/actor/director similarity
- Tested with production data: ~12 decades extracted from 970 items
- Observable impact: 24% of movie recommendations changed, 8% of TV
- Fixed: In-progress TV series no longer appear in recommendations

Series filtering fix and play status sync
- Fixed fully watched series appearing in recommendations
- Play status sync from source library when virtual items are scanned
- Rating proximity scoring feature
- Removed NFO file generation (Jellyfin doesn't read NFO for .strm files)
- Reduced debug logging noise

Fix NFO metadata parsing
- Fixed XML encoding (UTF-16 to UTF-8) so Jellyfin reads runtime correctly
- Added cast, directors, and writers to NFO files
- Added fileinfo/streamdetails for video/audio/subtitle stream selectors

NFO metadata and trailer support
- NFO files with full metadata (runtime, ratings, genres, studios, tags)
- Local trailer support via -trailer.strm files
- Movie folder structure for better metadata handling
- Fixed copy buttons on setup page
- Improved documentation

Initial beta release
- Per-user personalized recommendations for movies and TV shows
- Content-based filtering using TF-IDF embeddings
- Virtual library integration for universal client compatibility
- Configurable weighting (favorites, rewatches, recency)
- Abandoned series exclusion
- Daily scheduled updates with manual refresh option
- Complete privacy - all processing local
